commands:
set -euo pipefail
cd /app
if command -v qemu-system-x86_64 >/dev/null 2>&1; then QEMU=qemu-system-x86_64; elif command -v qemu-system-i386 >/dev/null 2>&1; then QEMU=qemu-system-i386; else echo 'NO_QEMU'; exit 1; fi
nohup "$QEMU" -m 512 -nographic -serial telnet:127.0.0.1:6665,server,nowait -monitor none -display none -drive file=/app/alpine.iso,media=cdrom,format=raw -boot d >/tmp/alpine-qemu.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid
sleep 2
printf 'QEMU=%s PID=%s\n' "$QEMU" "$(cat /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid)"
ps -p "$(cat /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid)" -o pid=,cmd=
facts: Required artifact(s) missing: A running qemu process using /app/alpine.iso, A reachable telnet service on 127.0.0.1:6665
